svg.title: The Audi S5 project
svg.desc: Manuel's lowered black Audi S5 B8.5 and 20-inch polished KC Forged wheels, drawn from his photographs. The S5 project. Audi S5 B8.5 / black / lowered 20" KC Forged. High-gloss polish. Split-Y spokes. Exposed hardware and a deep lip. The details are the point. Dream garage: Mazda RX-7. The other side of the lens. Wildlife, car photography and trips for a frame worth keeping. Sony α7 IV, Lightroom, Photoshop and DaVinci Resolve.

svg.title: Manuel's Audi S5 B8.5 — low, black, polished.
svg.desc: A lowered black Audi S5 B8.5 coupe, viewed from a low front three-quarter angle. The full car is visible, with silver mirror caps, facelift LED headlights, four grille rings and an S5 badge. Twenty-inch polished KC Forged wheels have five split-Y spoke pairs, a deep lip and exposed perimeter bolts. The car is parked while reflected studio light travels over the black paint and chrome.

svg.title: KC Forged — polished twenty-inch split-Y wheel.
svg.desc: A detailed front view of Manuel's polished KC Forged wheel: ten slender branched spokes, a deep stepped lip, exposed perimeter bolts, five wheel bolts and a KC centre emblem. The black S5 brake caliper is visible through the spokes. Violet and lime appear only as studio reflections in the chrome. The wheel stays still.
